name: Harlan Bagley
summary: At the Lionheart Armory in Stormwind City, Harlan Bagley tends to the arms and equipment his customers need. He is a human merchant in the Trade District, serving citizens and visiting adventurers from his shop on the district's northern side.

sections.title: The Lionheart Armory
sections.body: Harlan Bagley keeps the Lionheart Armory on the northern side of Stormwind's Trade District. He tends its stock and sells defensive gear from behind the counter. Trade and regional couriers bring supplies to the shop as the capital faces distant border conflicts and shortages.

faq.answer: Harlan Bagley is a human shopkeeper and tradesman who runs the Lionheart Armory, an equipment shop in Stormwind City's Trade District.

faq.q: Where can I find Harlan Bagley?
faq.answer: You can find Harlan Bagley inside the Lionheart Armory, on the northern side of the central square in Stormwind City's Trade District.

faq.q: What role does he play in Stormwind's commerce?
faq.answer: As a merchant in the kingdom's capital, Harlan Bagley supplies armor and gear. He sometimes hires adventurers to carry deliveries and secure supply shipments that keep his armory open.

angles.text: As an Alliance merchant, Harlan Bagley helps supply the kingdom's capital with gear and goods while threats across the surrounding territories put regular supply lines at risk.
